title: Distribute Candies
summary: Alice has an integer array candyType representing the types of candies she has.
statement: Alice has an integer array candyType representing the types of candies she has. The total number of candies, n, is even. According to the doctor's advice, Alice should eat exactly n / 2 candies to maintain her health. Alice wants to eat the maximum number of different types of candies possible while following this advice. Given the array candyType, return the maximum number of different candy types she can eat.
constraints: 2 <= len(candy_type) <= 10,000; length is even; values are in -100,000..100,000.
Choose exactly half the candies while maximizing the number of distinct types.
hints: Distinct types cannot exceed candies selected.
The answer is bounded by both half the list and the number of types.
If enough types exist, choose different ones; otherwise choose every available type once.
editorial: If enough types exist, choose different ones; otherwise choose every available type once.

tests.explanation: There are three types and three allowed candies, so take one of each.
Two candies may be eaten, but only one distinct type exists.
